objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated, translated and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of a document, not language-independent.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in a document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate when extended validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an archived document is retained.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of a document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, validity period and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to differentiate document types for clarity and evaluation.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties dialog or metadata container where document metadata, authorizations, workflow participants and distribution information are maintained.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific descriptive data maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose in document properties.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create a new document or added to a document as additional information or attachment.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure cover object to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format used by the editing client to open a document in a local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation of a saved document displayed on the web.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document, released and published directly via switches in properties, not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is nearing expiration.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow used for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation approval and acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Email used to inform users about workflow status, requests, releases, acknowledgements and change proposals.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using DHC VISION and participating in document management actions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignments and distribution.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person directly assigned in authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: technical_administration
objs.description: Actor that assigns users to author, reviewer and releaser user groups.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing user groups and persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display populated from distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report available for documents, instructions, monitoring and acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Link from a document to master data, another document or an original document.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked with documents through database integration.

evts.name: differentiate_document_type
evts.description: Differentiate between document types and levels for clarity and evaluation options.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically or manually link documents with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents and master data.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata, attributes, authorizations, workflow participants or distribution details in document properties.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: define_document_template
evts.description: Define one or more document templates for a document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with an implemented editing client.

evts.name: print_metadata_in_document
evts.description: Automatically print certain document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: Assign users to author, reviewer or releaser user groups by technical administration.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser releases a document after workflow-supported processing.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a workflow task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension and update the valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a revised new version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process a request for override with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, retain the request for documentation, revoke rights and start archive duration.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process a request for reactivation with workflow support.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated document by creating a new version and restoring maintained metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list entries and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons on a document distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: populate_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned to a document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, monitoring status or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Document levels have corresponding document types.
Document properties describe and control a document.
Metadata is maintained in document properties.
Attributes and metadata are grouped in categories.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
The editing client opens the document based on the existing source format.
A saved document is converted to PDF.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document.
Workflow-supported processing assigns workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
The system informs users of workflow tasks by e-mail notifications.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Users in the Archive group retain read access to archived documents.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
A distribution list is maintained for a document.
Acknowledgements are documented for documents.
Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
A document can have references to master data, other documents or original documents.
References can link a document to master data.
References can link a document to processes.
References can link a document to organizational units.
References can link a document to risks.
Documents can be linked with other documents or a local document can reference an original document.

o2e.description: Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with master data.
Document properties are maintained for the document.
New document is created by attachment of a new information object.
Corresponding document type is selected when creating a document.
Template is defined for a document type.
Upload is to an object cover.
Document is generated based on standard MS Office formats.
Editing uses the existing source format.
Authorizations are assigned for a document.
Reader authorizations are assigned via user group assignment.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer and releaser.
Technical administration assigns users to user groups.
Additional information is added to a document.
Attachment is added to a document.
Modification triggers a new version of associated main document.
Attachment is archived with release of next version of main document.
Approval process is initiated for document.
Co-author or author starts the release process.
Creator step is part of the release workflow.
Creation of the document is signed.
Workflow is canceled for subsequent participants.
Task is completed with electronic signature.
Change proposal is created for a document.
Employees with author rights can create change proposals.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new version of the document.
Document remains valid and valid until date is updated.
Attachments are also released and have same validity as main document.
Release of revised new version or suspension terminates process.
Request is created for selected document.
Users with write access can create the request.
Document is declared out of force and archived.
Attachments are declared invalid and archived.
Request is not deleted for documentation.
Document is physically deleted after archive period.
Corresponding document is selected for reactivation.
Only Business Admin group is permitted to create the request.
Invalidated document is reactivated with a new version.
Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.
Distribution list is maintained for the document.
User groups are assigned to distribution.
Assigned recipients are informed by email notification.
Directly assigned users and users of assigned groups are informed.
Users of assigned user groups are informed.
Notification occurs when new document version is released.
Acknowledgement is workflow-supported without a signature.
Completion of all acknowledgements is notified.
Notification is sent to author team.
Acknowledgements are listed depending on status.
New local document is created in a client.
Local addition document is created in the client.
Reference to original document is created.
